auditor_tom: Hey team, auditor asks for a compact evidence bundle for the 2024-09-12 inference incident. Need: raw CloudTrail + KMS admin event JSONs (GenerateDataKey/Decrypt/DescribeKey) for 02:00-06:00 UTC, a CSV mapping requestId->ciphertextBlob->envelopeKeyId->principal, RBAC snapshots for implicated service accounts, and a one-paragraph control mapping to SOC2/ISO. Can you confirm approach and ETA?

jess: plan accepted. I'll pull CloudTrail raw events and the KMS SIEM export, correlate by requestId, and produce reconciliation.csv.

rick: add Vault audit for token/secret operations in the same window. that'll show service-account credential churn. sample vault command: `vault audit enable file file_path=/var/log/vault_audit.log` and for extraction `grep "2024-09-12T0" /var/log/vault_audit.log | jq .`

anjali: I'll snapshot RBAC and gitops commits. commands: `kubectl get rolebinding --all-namespaces -o yaml > /tmp/rb-snap-20240912.yaml` and `git log --since="2024-09-11" --until="2024-09-13" -- k8s/rbac/ > gitops_rbac_range.txt`.

jess: Splunk snippet I used earlier to pull KMS logs: ```index=aws_kms (eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=Decrypt) | table _time, requestID, requestParameters.ciphertextBlob, responseElements.keyId, userIdentity.principalId```

auditor_tom: auditors need raw event JSONs. okay to deliver raw to the evidence bucket and a redacted copy for broader distribution? also note retention config.

rick: yes raw -> s3://redwood-evidence/INC-4312/raw/ (restricted). redacted -> s3://redwood-evidence/INC-4312/redacted/ . retention: CloudTrail primary 90d, SIEM 365d, evidence-bucket lifecycle: cold archive indefinite per retention.policy. I'll include config references.

anjali: confirm rotation behavior: we will NOT pause rotations. We will capture Vault rotation job logs and any gitops rolebinding changes. current gitops runbook shows no RBAC rollouts in that 4h window.

jess: include a short statement about single-use envelope keys: "GenerateDataKey returns a ciphertextBlob (envelope). Each request derives a unique data key; ciphertextBlobs are not reused by design. See code reference: `kms.GenerateDataKey()` per request."

evidence-bot: Evidence package created: s3://redwood-evidence/INC-4312/20240912-evidence.tar.gz (sha256: f2d9b4c9e8a4...a7). Manifest: s3://redwood-evidence/INC-4312/manifest.json

jess: deliverables: cloudtrail_raw_events.json, kms_siem_export.json, vault_audit_extract.json, reconciliation.csv, rolebindings_snapshot.yaml, gitops_commits.txt, README_control_map.md. README will include one-paragraph control mapping (SOC2 CC6/CC7, ISO A.10) and retention citations. ETA 6h.

auditor_tom: perfect. if you find gaps (missing requestIDs or truncated events) call them out in README and mark for follow-up. thanks.
